messages.content: Set a countdown for 5 mins reminding me to text Rajh

function.name: set_volume
function.description: Set the global volume for all audio playback. The volume level can be specified as an integer between 0 (mute) and 100 (maximum loudness). Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

volume.description: The volume level to be set. Valid values range from 0 (mute) to 100 (maximum loudness).

function.name: set_alarm
function.description: Set an alarm for a specific time. The time can be specified in various formats, including 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS', 'HH:MM:SS', 'HH:MM', or with AM/PM notations. For example, '2023-06-01 09:30:00', '14:45', or '9:30 AM'. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

alarm_time.description: The alarm time in a recognized format, such as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' for specific date and time, 'HH:MM:SS' for time only, 'HH:MM' for hour and minutes, or 'HH:MM AM/PM' for 12-hour format.

purpose.description: The purpose of setting the alarm. This could be a brief reminder or a description of the event.

function.name: set_countdown
function.description: Sets a countdown timer based on the provided duration, which should be specified in either hours, minutes, or a combination of both. For example, valid inputs include '1 hour', '30 minutes', and '1 hour 30 minutes'. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

duration.description: The countdown duration specified as a string in one of the following formats: 'X hour(s) Y minute(s)', 'X hour(s)', or 'Y minute(s)'. Examples: '1 hour 30 minutes', '45 minutes', '2 hours'.

purpose.description: An optional description of the purpose for the countdown timer.

function.name: play_song
function.description: Play a song based on the user's search query. The function searches for the song in the music database and plays the first match. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: The search query for the song, which can include song title, artist, or album.

volume.description: The volume level at which the song should be played, ranging from 0 to 100.

shuffle.description: Indicates whether to shuffle the playlist after playing the requested song.

repeat.description: Specifies the repeat mode for the song playback.
